versions.changelog:
Initial release of xiaolan-erp skill – AI-driven ERP for inventory, purchasing, sales, costs, and reporting.

- Enables full ERP flow driven by natural language AI conversations.
- Guides setup of organizations, users, and permissions, with support for both solo and multi-user teams.
- Provides step-by-step onboarding for warehouses, items, suppliers/customers, and transactions.
- Robust error handling and clear user prompts for common issues.
- Easy MCP integration; minimal setup required for both local and cloud deployments.
